parent_physx_analysis_provenance.point_count_definition: Actual ground-filtered contact points with individual normal force strictly >5 N; not all geometric contacts
parent_physx_analysis_provenance.support_load_eligibility_gate: recorded point count > 0 AND aggregate upward ground Fz > 5 N
parent_physx_analysis_provenance.ground_force_definition: Sum of measured ground-normal force vectors only, not tangential friction force; Fz is world upward component
limitations: Zero thresholded count/load eligibility does not establish geometric separation, flight or task failure. Weak contacts <=5 N cannot be reconstructed.
Ground sensors provide training reward only; unchanged actor/critic layout is checked, and no new sensor observation is assumed.
Every contact statistic uses the original 5ms native clock. Legacy contact metadata may still say20ms; no clock is replaced by that label.
Duty includes both native-sample and zero-order-held time fractions. Boundary missing-contact runs are censored observed durations.
Force jumps are differences between adjacent 5ms recorded normal-force samples, in N, not a derivative or measured acceleration.
Physical full horizon ends6.98s but reference ends6.96s. Full tracking is unavailable without extrapolation; explicit reference-overlap tracking is separate.
Training mg cache is not an evaluation mass readback; evaluation force remains N, without inferred mass normalization.
HF RMS uses linear detrend, Hann window and channel-mean one-sided Parseval normalization, frequencies strictly above10Hz; not a pose filter.
Each body component retains its own frame/units. Intended yaw, nonzero sideslip and free absolute height are not new rejection criteria.
One seed/checkpoint/episode per policy is descriptive only. Contact, tracking and full-body video must be reviewed together; no automatic pass threshold is invented.
Same PhysX-trained checkpoint is evaluated in both engines; this is not a MuJoCo-trained PPO comparison.
Both use recorded ground-filtered count>0 and the separate count>0 &aggregateFz>5N load gate; absence is not geometric flight.
Contact patch discretization, instantaneous MuJoCo constraint forces and PhysX sensor aggregation remain engine-specific; equal nominal mu is not equal contact dynamics.
MuJoCo root_state_writes=1 denotes frame0 initialization, then zero prescribed-root writes during stepping in the audited legacy evaluator.
No actor/checkpoint bytes are downloaded; actor hash audit is metadata-bound. Local MuJoCo rollout hash is reported, but legacy report does not bind it by SHA.
Full physical horizon6.98s exceeds reference6.96s; full tracking remains unavailable, never endpoint-extrapolated.
One seed/checkpoint/episode is descriptive. Contact/load/HF differences do not define an automatic pass or stable-contact guarantee.
